title: Milonga Studio figure
description: One figure file in db/figures/. This schema is for editors (autocomplete and as-you-type checks) and describes exactly what parseFigureDefinition in src/libs/dance/authoring.mts accepts; test/db/figureSchema.test.mts keeps the two in step. Whether the steps make sense as dancing is checked when the seed runs. See db/FIGURES.md.

$schema.description: Path to this schema, for editors: "../figure.schema.json".

name.description: Shown in the library. Must be unique across the figure files.

style.description: Free-form tag that groups the library, such as "tango", "waltz" or "cha-cha".

slow.description: Beats in an S when steps use "length". Default 2; a Q is half.

notes.description: Free text for whoever edits the file. Not stored or shown in the app.

expectBeats.description: How many beats the figure should last, checked against the steps' timing.

skipChecks.description: Checks to leave out, only for figures known to be wrong that are kept until rewritten. Say why in notes.

expectEnd.description: Where the figure should finish, checked against the steps (within 1 mm).

action.description: A direction relative to the dancer's facing (or degrees clockwise from forward), an offset in metres ({ "forward": 0.9, "right": 0.2 }), "close", "in place" or "pivot".

forward.description: Metres forward (negative for back), from the facing before the step's turn.

right.description: Metres to the right (negative for left), from the facing before the step's turn.

turnAmount.description: A fraction of a full turn: a number such as 0.125, or text such as "1/8".

foot.description: Usually left out: the free foot (or for a pivot, the standing foot) is used.

rise.description: Rise at the end of the step, in metres. Default 0.

pointing.description: How much further round than the body the moving foot points when it lands, from the body's facing after the step's turn (a chart's "body turns less"). Default: the way the body faces.

bodyOffset.description: Pelvis displacement in metres, forward/right of this dancer after the turn. Omission returns to zero.

riseTiming.description: "late": the rise holds and changes at the end of the step (a chart's "at end of"). Default "even": steadily across the step.

footwork.description: The chart's footwork: H heel, T toe, B ball, F flat, in order ("HT", "T", "TH"). The first letter decides how the foot lands: heel first (toes up), toe or ball first (heel up), or flat.

duration.description: Explicit action length in beats, with beat timing. A weightless free-foot path can overlap the other foot's supporting action.

weight.description: Boolean full/no transfer, or an end share from 0 to 1 for a phased transfer.

air.description: true for an airborne action (boleo, gancho): out and back, no weight.

cross.description: true when the step crosses the feet on purpose (a whisk's cross behind). Without it a step may not put the left foot to the right of the right foot.

pathSetOff.description: Arc departure in degrees clockwise from the dancer before the step; overrides the path preset. Requires a curved path when authored.

path.description: The foot curves instead of going straight, landing where the step says. "around the front": it sets off the way the dancer faces. "around the back": it sets off diagonally back towards the side it lands on, to uncross feet the way they crossed. "around the standing foot": on a turning step it circles the standing foot the way the body turns, keeping its side of the body through a big turn. "auto": straight if that keeps the foot clear of the standing feet, otherwise the gentlest curve (at most 12 cm off the straight line, 15% longer) that does.

partner.description: An action, or an object with the action in "go" and this partner's own options.

step.description: One moment: "both" (the follow mirrors the lead), or "lead" and/or "follow". Timing is "beat" or "length", one style per figure.

turnCentre.description: With "both" and a "turn": what the couple turns around. "lead": he takes the step as written and she goes round him; "follow": she takes the mirror of it and he goes round her; "between": the point halfway between them takes it. Default: whoever the step sends backward (between them for a step straight to the side).

hold.description: The hold to check at this row's end instead of closed hold or promenade, with the ordinary tolerances. "opposed promenade": opposite-facing and side by side, follow nominally 35 cm right and 10 cm forward of lead. "closed, follow turned 1/8 right": closed hold's position with the follow facing 1/8 right of square (the Natural Twist Turn's steps 3 and 4). "transition": a moment between two holds within one beat (stepping onto the promenade spot before swivelling); its end must lie between the holds checked either side of it (body within the usual distance of the line between them, facing within the usual tolerance of the turn between them), and a row ending later in the same beat must be checked in hold. Omit for the ordinary closed/promenade checks.

beat.description: When the step starts, counting from 1 (3.5 for "3&").

length.description: A slow or a quick; steps follow one another.

label.description: One label for both partners, or one each.

pointing.description: How much further round than the body the moving foot points: one amount, or one per partner ({ "follow": { "right": "1/8" } }).

footwork.description: The chart's footwork: one for each partner the row applies to, or one each ({ "lead": "HT", "follow": "TH" }).

path.description: A curved route for both dancers, or only the named partners; omitted partners keep their ordinary route.

pathSetOff.description: Arc departure: one value for both dancers, or separate lead/follow values in their own frames.

point.description: [x, y] in metres, in the figure's own frame (+y is forward, +x is the lead's right).
